name: Task Manager list widget
summary: Retired 2026-10-26: the flat tasks list widget is gone; the task manager widget is the one place to see and open task manager items.
description: Retired. The widget listed the Task Manager's items in one flat list on the right widget bar. Joe (ccsliinc), 2026-10-26: "yes, and retire the flat tasks list too" (issue #2531). The original task manager and all task managers widgets went with it and TM Mark II took their name: it is now the task manager (and all task managers). A saved placement or layout slot of a retired widget reads back as the task manager in the same slot (placements server side in src/core/widget_placement/retired_widgets.py, the Home, terminal and war room grids through the replaced block of src/data/widgets.json), so nothing goes blank; the swapped value is written back once through the ordinary preference write, every dashboard, session arrangement and widget bar included. The row list the widget drew stays as the plugin SDK's TaskStatusList, behind the status counts on a Task Manager project row.
where: Gone. A saved copy now shows the task manager in the same place.
how_to: Open edit layout and add the task manager widget where the tasks list was.
Press open in task manager on a row of the Task Manager's status counts to see the list of a project.
examples: A tasks list that sat on the right widget bar before 2026-10-26 now shows the task manager there.
media_exempt: A widget whose screenshots are captured before the next version bump.
